```yaml
name: Deploy Pages One

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      
      - name: Build docs with corrected base path
        run: |
          npm run build
          # Fix base path in vitepress config
          sed -i 's|base: "/"|base: "./"|g' docs/.vitepress/config.mjs
          npm run docs:build
      
      - name: Generate zip for gh-pages deployment
        run: |
          cd docs/.vitepress/dist
          zip -r ../pagesone-deploy.zip .
          cd ../..
      
      - name: Upload zip artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pagesone-deploy
          path: docs/pagesone-deploy.zip
          retention-days: 1
          
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./docs/.vitepress/dist
          publish_branch: gh-pages
          force_orphan: true
```
